policy: Fixed-point bidirectional traversal over the following canonical dependency kinds, including old and new edges for relation changes/deletions. Conservative relevance closure checks every applicable invariant on affected objects. No hidden NLP edges.
invariants: Every applicable invariant listed in object-schema/types.json; graph-global conflict groups involving affected targets/topics also checked.
changed: Working tree versus HEAD for local semantic/revision diff; acceptance revisions always use recognized canonical baseline.
againstCanonical: Real merge-base B, canonical accepted tip T, proposal H; concurrent unequal changes to the same semantic object surface STALE_OBJECT and SEMANTIC_CONFLICT; no latest-writer choice.
